title: SIDESTORY: MEDJEHTIQEDTI BOUND OPEN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: MEDJEHTIQEDTI BOUND OPEN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Medjehtiqedti Bound event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
Phase 1 [Ritual of the Temple]
Phase 2 [Theaters of the Street]
[Classic Plays]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Classic Plays] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Varkáris], New Verses of Athenius Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Ostracon, etc.
[Astynomos' Office]
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Ostracon by clearing event stages and completing [Classic Plays]. Ostracon can be used to redeem items from [Astynomos' Office].

REWARDS: Varkáris's Tokens, New Verses of Athenius Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permits, Bloodline of Combat Collection - Dreadnaught for Beagle, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in [Public Affairs].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – QUESTER IN FROZEN MOMENTS
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Quester in Frozen Moments], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★: Perfumer the Distilled / Spuria

NOTE: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star Operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game:
★★★★★: Perfumer the Distilled
★★★★★: Varkáris
NOTE:

- Operator Varkáris is currently ONLY available from the Medjehtiqedti Bound event, and is NOT available in [Quester in Frozen Moments] headhunting or any [Standard Headhunting] and [Kernel Headhunting].
- Titi and Perfumer the Distilled will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after July 6, 2026, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Titi, Perfumer the Distilled, and Varkáris will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.
04 SEMBLANCE CARRIER SYSTEM ADDED
UPDATE TIME: June 22, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: After the update, the Semblance Carrier system will be added. This system consists of Fashion Gallery, Curated Gallery, the Collection, and Fashion Collections. It will continuously catalog various cosmetic items, and you can earn rewards for completing sets.
Among them, Fashion Collections allows you to customize collection covers using owned outfits, cosmetic items, and stickers, and they can be added to your Profile for public display.

◆ After the update, you can deploy Operators while the game is paused during battle stages. In addition, the dynamic art on the main screen can be displayed at a larger scale, with improved visual detail.
05 MEMORIAL GALLERY SYSTEM ADDED
UPDATE TIME: June 22, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: After the update, the Memorial Gallery system will be added. It can be accessed from Score - Memories. In this system, you can review all unlocked CG scenes and select your favorite images to add to your collection.
◆ CG Unlock Requirement: Complete the corresponding story segments. (For chapters already read before the feature goes live, the related CGs will be unlocked automatically.)
06 CAMBRIAN SERIES NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Cambrian Series - Homecoming Night for Blaze the Igniting Spark
Cambrian Series - Dazzling Blue for Entelechia
07 RE-EDITION OUTFITS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - Curator for Reed the Flame Shadow
EPOQUE Collection - Private Study for Mint
0011 Yun Series - Away From Dust for Jieyun
Fashion Review
Fashion Review II
NOTE:

◆After participating in Fashion Review using Orundum, players will randomly get an Outfit from a specified pool, and each player may participate in Fashion Review and Fashion Review II once each during the event period. Turns into a Review Ticket if all Fashion Review items have been obtained (allowing you to redeem an Outfit of your choice in the latest season of Rhodes Fashion Review).

◆Fashion Review includes 18 outfits, including: Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flowers FA018 for Eyjafjalla and Coral Coast Collection - Silent Night DN02 for Shining; Fashion Review II includes 16 outfits, including: Test Collection - The Law for Saria and Icefield Messenger Series - York's Bise for SilverAsh.
08 NEW FURNITURE SET – NEW VERSES OF ATHENIUS
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed furniture, New Verses of Athenius will be available.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Medjehtiqedti Bound event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
09 LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at the Store for a limited time.
Medic Chip Pack
CONTENTS: Medic Dualchip * 4, Medic Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
Hero's Legacy Funding Box
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 13, LMD * 300,000
10 NEW REDEEMABLE AVAILABLE IN [DISTINCTIONS] AND [UNIVERSAL CERTIFICATES EXCHANGE AREA]
UPDATE TIME: June 22, 2026, 08:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: New redeemable in [Distinctions] and [Universal Certificates Exchange Area]:
EPOQUE Collection - Eggcellent Craftsman for Greyy
11 2026 COMMEMORATIVE LIMITED-TIME SIGN-IN EVENT
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 7 days to receive generous rewards, including: Event Exclusive Furniture, Orundum, and more.
Day 1: LMD * 30000, Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1
Day 2: Recruitment Permit * 5, Chip Catalyst *1
Day 3: Skill Summary - 1 * 30, Orundum *200
Day 4: Skill Summary - 2 *20, 'Pass On the Hope' Mailbox Furniture *1
Day 5: Furniture Part * 300, Tactical Battle Record *20
Day 6: Pure Gold * 20, Module Data Block *1
Day 7: Expedited Plan *5, Skill Summary - 3 * 8
NOTE: For the [Emergency Sanity Concentrate] obtained from this login event, please refer to the in-game display for the expiration time.
12 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN - CELEBRATION - KERNEL
DETAILS: During the Limited-time Headhunting [Celebration - Kernel], the first 6-star Operator obtained is guaranteed to be an unowned 6-star Operator from [Kernel Headhunting]:

Exusiai / Siege / Ifrit / Eyjafjalla / Angelina / Shining / Nightingale / Hoshiguma / Saria / SilverAsh / Skadi / Ch'en / Schwarz / Hellagur / Magallan / Mostima / Blaze / Aak / Ceobe / Bagpipe / Phantom / Weedy / Rosa / Suzuran / Thorns / Eunectes / Surtr / Blemishine / Mudrock / Mountain / Archetto / Saga / Passenger / Kal'tsit / Carnelian / Pallas / Mizuki / Saileach / Fartooth / Flametail / Gnosis

- During [Celebration - Kernel] banners, the first 6-star Operator obtained is guaranteed to be an unowned 6-star Kernel Operator from the list of available Operators. If all available 6-star Operators are already owned, the first 6-star Operator obtained will be a random 6-star Operator from the list of available Operators.

- The cumulative number of rolls that count towards this system will not carry over between different [Celebration - Kernel] banners, and this number will be reset at the end of each [Celebration - Kernel] banner. The increased probability of obtaining a 6-star Operator will also not be applied to any subsequent [Celebration - Kernel] banners.

- During [Celebration - Kernel] banners, the number of rolls without obtaining any 6-star Operator will not be accumulated or applied to any other banner, and will remain separate from any accumulated rolls on other banners.
NOTE:

- The 6-star, 5-star, and 4-star Operators available in the [Celebration - Kernel] banners are all Operators featured in [Kernel Headhuntings]. When obtaining an Operator through [Celebration - Kernel], Universal Certificates and Kernel Tokens (if you already own that Operator) will be granted as well.
13 LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: During the event, the following pack will be available at the Store for a limited time.
Headhunting Pack - Kernel (Limited to 2 purchases)
CONTENTS: Ten-roll Kernel Headhunting Permit * 1
Please stay tuned for more information!
